note: The authoritative list of everything LabTutor may answer from. Nothing is ingested unless it is declared here, which is what stops material of one tier being mixed into another. 'present: false' means the file is expected but absent from this checkout; ingestion reports it as blocked rather than skipping it silently.

documents.title: IACHY102 Engineering Chemistry Laboratory manual (transcription)
documents.notes: SOURCE OF TRUTH, and what backend/rag/retrieval.py actually ingests (LABTUTOR_MANUAL_PDF defaults to this path). A markdown transcription of the manual, not the PDF binary itself -- no PDF was deposited in this repo (see manual/README.md for why). Authority for experiment numbering, scope, procedures, formulas, calculations, terminology, software workflow, tables, expected relationships and worked examples present in the transcription. Screenshots/figures are NOT present in this transcription (visual: false) -- a question needing the manual's actual page images cannot be answered visually from this document today.

documents.title: IACHY102 Engineering Chemistry Laboratory manual (2026-27, original PDF)
documents.notes: The original PDF this deployment is transcribed from. NOT committed to this repo (department course material; redistribution is their call -- see .gitignore) and NOT what is currently ingested -- iachy102_manual_markdown is. If this PDF is later deposited at this path, ingestion should be extended to prefer it (for visual/figure grounding) while treating iachy102_manual_markdown as a fallback, not the reverse.

documents.title: BACHY105 Applied Chemistry Laboratory manual (superseded)
documents.notes: The manual the first two build sessions targeted. Retained in the manifest only so that a stray copy on someone's machine is recognised and REFUSED rather than ingested as current. Ingestion must never index a superseded document.

documents.title: Experiment 7 student worksheet
documents.notes: Officially supplied material accompanying the experiment. Authoritative about itself, subordinate to the manual about the experiment. Where it contradicts Tier A the conflict is flagged, never silently resolved. Not present in this checkout.

documents.title: Experiment 7 demonstrator notes
documents.notes: Not present in this checkout. Note for whoever adds it: demonstrator notes may contain answer keys. Anything ingested from a professor-facing document is reachable by a student question, so review it for answer-key content before ingesting, and keep it out of Socratic-mode retrieval entirely.

documents.title: IACHY102 Exp 7/8 supplementary procedural detail
documents.notes: Genuinely-new procedural detail (O2 build sequence, Gabedit version, ORCA run command) confirmed present in the fuller course PDF/DOCX but absent from the markdown manual transcription, and confirmed absent nowhere else. Also holds the 'Where things are on screen' paragraphs for Exp 7, read from the DOCX screenshots with Vertex vision and hand-checked (toolbar/menu locations, ORCA input dialog fields, Run dialog, output file layout, Avogadro Orbitals panel). Table 1/2 numeric values are NOT here -- they are blank in every source seen, which manual/IACHY102_manual.md already states correctly. DOCX paragraph 212 (reference HOMO/LUMO ranges) and example numbers inside screenshots are deliberately excluded.

documents.title: LabTutor curated adjacent knowledge
documents.notes: Written for LabTutor to answer Level 2 questions: broader theory, general software concepts, background the manual does not cover. NEVER presented as the manual; every answer drawn from it carries a visible supplementary label. May not supply procedure, formula or numbering for any experiment.

documents.title: LabTutor golden QA dataset
documents.notes: Evaluation material only. Explicitly NOT indexed for retrieval: a system that can retrieve its own test set scores well for the wrong reason. The ingester refuses any document with indexable=false.
